selection: All tracked TypeScript/TSX/JavaScript/JSX files under packages/ and excalidraw-app/, excluding test, tests, __tests__, __snapshots__, testdata directories and .test/.spec files; package.json and tsconfig*.json in those trees; root LICENSE, package.json, tsconfig.json. No downloaded dependencies, binary/static assets, generated graphs, or repository history. Source-audit fixture, not a complete browser-build distribution.

transformations.description: Only CRLF-to-LF and required final-newline normalization; all other source bytes preserved.

digest_algorithm: SHA256 of each sorted src-relative path + NUL + raw SHA256(file bytes), concatenated.
